text: Atlas Mower user manual, version 3. The Atlas Mower uses the Helios-2 battery pack, which gives about 120 minutes of mowing on a full charge. Charging from empty to full takes roughly 90 minutes on the standard dock. Error code E17 means the blade motor is overheating. Stop the mower, remove grass from under the deck, and let it cool for 20 minutes. If E17 returns, contact Northwind Support. Error code E22 means the boundary wire signal is lost. Check that the dock is powered and that the boundary wire has no breaks. The Helios-2 battery should be stored indoors during winter at around 50 percent charge.

Northwind Robotics is a consumer robotics company founded in 2016 in Rotterdam. Its CEO is Marcus Veldt. The company sells the Atlas Mower, a robotic lawn mower, and the Kestrel Drone, an inspection drone for roofs and gutters. Batteries for both products are supplied by VoltaCell, a manufacturer based in Poland. GreenYard Supplies is the largest reseller of Northwind products in Germany and Austria.

Safety notice: voluntary recall of Helios-2 battery packs. In March 2025 Northwind Robotics announced a voluntary recall of Helios-2 battery packs produced between June and September 2024 by its supplier VoltaCell. A small number of cells could swell when charged in temperatures above 40 degrees Celsius. Affected owners receive a free replacement Helios-3 pack. The recall was coordinated by Dr. Lena Okafor, head of product safety at Northwind Robotics.
Kestrel Drone technical specification. The Kestrel Drone has a flight time of 35 minutes and a maximum range of 4 km. It carries a 48 megapixel camera for roof and gutter inspection.

Page 2: Batteries. The Kestrel Drone uses VoltaCell K-series batteries, which are not affected by the Helios-2 recall. Firmware updates are released by the Northwind Robotics software team every quarter.

# Northwind Robotics Refund Policy Customers who buy the Atlas Mower directly from Northwind Robotics can request a full refund within 30 days of delivery. The mower must be returned in its original packaging with the charging dock. After 30 days and up to 90 days, Northwind Robotics offers store credit instead of a cash refund. Refunds are processed by the Finance team in Rotterdam within 10 business days. Orders placed through resellers such as GreenYard Supplies follow the reseller's own refund policy, not this one.

شرایط گارانتی محصولات نورث‌ویند ماشین چمن‌زن Atlas Mower دارای دو سال گارانتی قطعات و خدمات است. باتری Helios-2 به‌طور جداگانه یک سال گارانتی دارد. آسیب ناشی از استفاده در باران شدید یا تعمیر توسط افراد غیرمجاز مشمول گارانتی نمی‌شود. برای ثبت درخواست گارانتی، شماره سریال دستگاه و فاکتور خرید لازم است.
